subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be limited to documenting the existing pi-tui multiline shortcuts, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed newline insertion, but configurable send/newline behavior would create public config, CLI, or keybinding API surface under the repository's high bar for new config.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior in docs and /help while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow supported preference for send/newline bindings with default and customized behavior covered by tests.

options.title: Fold Into Composer Backlog
options.body: Track configurable send keys together with external editor, long-prompt modal, and vi-mode composer work.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior in docs and /help while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest prior review context and TUI/pi-tui ownership history for choosing the product/API shape.
